common.targetHost: Claude Code CLI workspace, proposed only
common.sourceDisposition: original proposal; inspect actual pinned sources and their licence/notice evidence; do not claim clearance from this fixture
common.rootConstraints: fresh case-specific draft disjoint from pinned source checkout, baseline, evidence and managed/protected paths; no symlinks or links crossing these roots; never install
common.requiredBaseline: empty unless case specifies protected file; compare every baseline byte before/after
constraints: all three shared Skills declared once
no managed/global/source writes, provisioning, network, publication, credentials or live sessions
separate actual authorization, availability and paid invocation
record unresolved native delivery and rights/quality evidence truthfully
acceptance: AC-1 four scoped files and preserved baseline
AC-2 manifest uses actual BundleDefinition and BundlePrerequisites fields
AC-3 shared Skills once and dormant absent explicit request
AC-4 required/optional dependency status and leader responsibility accurate
AC-5 complete delivery/provenance/check gaps and independent handback
common.checks: caller chooses applicable existing offline checks and records actual commands, raw output and exits; unavailable checks remain open
bindingInputs: absolute isolated draft, baseline and evidence roots
canonical job bytes and caller-held SHA-256 digest

case-1.title: Data-rich Domain with no integrations
case-1.name: fixture-review-domain
case-1.description: Review supplied local changes and hand off findings.
case-1.taskRequirements: Review supplied architecture notes and change list for accessibility, test impact and unresolved decisions; no external integration is needed.
case-1.authorization: Local draft authorized; no setup or external action authorized.
acceptanceExtra: Preserve explicit empty prerequisites and no-leader finding.

case-2.title: Organization with empty prerequisites
case-2.name: fixture-organization-empty
case-2.description: Coordinate supplied local engineering and creative review.
case-2.taskRequirements: Coordinate supplied local design and engineering notes; no current integrations.
case-2.authorization: Local draft authorized; no provisioning authorized.
acceptanceExtra: Organization leader retains provisioning responsibility despite empty list.

case-3.title: Required integration unavailable
case-3.name: fixture-required-integration
case-3.description: Prepare a local release proposal with a repository-dependent action.
case-3.taskRequirements: GitHub is unavailable in the hypothetical target session; a repository action depends on it. Prepare independent local proposal work only.
case-3.authorization: Local draft authorized; no connection, repository action or publication authorized.
acceptanceExtra: Block the dependent repository action without inventing availability.

case-4.title: Optional integration unavailable
case-4.name: fixture-optional-integration
case-4.description: Review supplied local material with optional repository context.
case-4.taskRequirements: GitHub is unavailable; reviewing the supplied local material does not depend on it.
case-4.authorization: Local draft authorized; no connection or repository action authorized.
acceptanceExtra: Disclose degraded local-only scope and do not call a mock integration output.

case-5.title: Already authorized setup
case-5.name: fixture-existing-authorization
case-5.description: Plan a local proposal with an already authorized future setup.
case-5.taskRequirements: The hypothetical human already authorized project-scope setup of GitHub for this same task; target-session availability is not observed.
case-5.authorization: Same-scope project setup authorization is supplied for future leader work; this authoring job performs no setup, sign-in, repository action or paid invocation.
acceptanceExtra: Reuse supplied authorization without equating it with current availability or provider spending consent.

case-6.title: Missing Claude plugin reload evidence
case-6.name: fixture-plugin-reload
case-6.description: Plan a local proposal with a selected plugin route.
case-6.taskRequirements: For this hypothetical Claude CLI session the plugin is listed; the user has not reported the reviewed reload and ToolSearch has not established callable tools.
case-6.authorization: Local draft only; no setup, reload, tool invocation or repository action.
acceptanceExtra: Report missing user reload and actual ToolSearch evidence without assuming availability.

case-7.title: Scoped update with protected note
case-7.name: fixture-update-domain
case-7.description: Review supplied local changes and hand off findings.
case-7.taskRequirements: The existing proposal is already compatible; preserve it unchanged and retain the protected note byte-for-byte.

baselineFiles.protected-notes.txt:
Owner: unknown
Do not change this note.
baselineFiles.bundles.json: Build the case 1 concrete manifest using fixture-update-domain as key and name, then record exact bytes and hash.
baselineFiles.leader-responsibility.md: Existing compatible leader responsibility; no leader, no current prerequisites.
baselineFiles.bindings.json: Prepare a complete evidence record for the existing candidate; explicitly leave native delivery and quality unverified, bind actual source paths and retain exact bytes.
baselineFiles.report.json: Prepare a complete existing report for the baseline, including actual bound identity, other-file inventory and explicit deferred self-hash; retain exact bytes.

case-7.authorization: Only unchanged reuse/update of the four proposal paths; no modification to protected note or external action.
acceptanceExtra: Complete inventory/diff identifies unchanged proposal and protected note.

case-8.title: Incomplete native leader
case-8.name: fixture-unrealized-leader
case-8.description: Propose a cross-functional leader awaiting separate realization.
case-8.taskRequirements: The proposed leader has no inspected shared core, contract or target-native realization in this fixture; do not create these artifacts.
case-8.authorization: Local proposal only; no realization, installation or Host run.
